## Labcoat Leni 14.1

Perham & Sykora (2012): *Are splattered cadavers distracting?*

Is recall affected by the sound played while learning letter sequences?

- Two within-subject factors: sound (quiet, liked or disliked music) × position in the list (1–8)
- `quiet_pos1` to `disliked_pos8`: probability of correctly recalling a letter
